eventKinds.rebase: Issuer changed holders' displayed balances without a transfer (scaled-UI multiplier)
eventKinds.pause: Trading or transfers paused by the issuer
eventKinds.shortfall: Issuer could not source or deliver the underlying
eventKinds.governance: Authority keys or upgrade rights changed hands

eventKinds.sector: Event affecting several programmes at once

events.summary: 97 of Ondo's 212 Solana mints were paused at read time (reason unavailable_in_session, per Ondo's asset API); the Pausable extension and the freeze authority are the only compliance controls actually live on Solana, because the TransferHook extension is initialised with a null program on every mint sampled.

Backpack's own risk disclosure says tokens withdrawn to a self-custody wallet 'may be economically worthless to you' because redemption needs conditions that self-custody does not satisfy; ACATS/DTCC brokerage transfers, dividends, splits and voting are all listed as 'still being worked on'.
events.source: stocks/data/issuers/backpack-securities-spcx.json (T&C and Risk Disclosure Statement dated 2026-06-10; holdings page and FAQ read 2026-09-16)

events.summary: All eight Shift mints were topped up in one ten-second batch by each mint's own hot keypair with a shared fee payer; no SHIFT program, oracle or proof-of-reserve account appears in the transactions, contrary to the documented 'PoR-gated' mint architecture.
events.source: stocks/data/issuers/shift.json (rpc:getSignaturesForAddress on the eight mint authorities)

events.summary: OPENAI's scaled-UI-amount multiplier moved from 1 to 1.4861347 at 16:30 UTC, restating every holder's displayed balance up by about 48.6 % without any transfer and without a public explanation. The issuer can unilaterally rebase balances.
events.source: stocks/data/issuers/prestocks.json (Solana RPC getAccountInfo on the OPENAI mint)

events.summary: Ventuals sunset its pre-IPO perpetual markets; OPENAI settled at $1,341.80 and ANTHROPIC at $1,618.90 at frozen TWAPs chosen by the operator. Holders had no instrument that survived the shutdown.

Binance, Bybit and Bitget cancelled their tokenized-SpaceX IPO campaigns after Kraken's xStocks could not source shares; Binance unwound roughly $557 M of subscriptions from 27,689 addresses with zero allocations. Backpack's SPCX, which had custodied shares through its own brokerage chain, was reported unaffected.

Anthropic and OpenAI declared SPV-routed transfers of their stock void and warned that tokenized exposure 'may have no value'; PreStocks ANTHROPIC fell about 34–38 % and OPENAI about 39–46 % within days. Tessera's T-OpenAI carries the same exposure question.
events.source: stocks/data/issuers/prestocks.json and tessera.json (CoinDesk and The Block, 2026-05-13)

events.summary: Step Finance wound down all operations, including Remora Markets, after a January treasury compromise (about 261,854 SOL moved out of the project's control). Exit liquidity was posted on Manifest on 2026-03-02 at the prior Friday's close; residual supply and about 3,600 holders remain on chain.

Upgrade authority for Tessera's token and referral programs moved from a Squads multisig to a single Fireblocks wallet, which now holds upgrade, mint, transfer-fee and referral-config authority across all programs and mints.
